abstract: We study the rank-ten K3-type cohomology selected from even double covers of type-$(1,3)$ abelian surfaces. On the actual double cover of the resolved Kummer surface, we determine the full anti-invariant lattice as $U^2\oplus D_{12}(-1)$ and prove that six exceptional differences saturate to a primitive $D_6(-1)$. Their complement is $U^2\oplus D_6(-1)$, with determinant four. Odd unimodular extensions identify these lattices, and explicit discriminant gluing extends the pencil monodromy to the K3 lattice. We include a complete proof of period rank eight. Assuming precisely Lemma 5.5 and Theorem 6.1 of OpenAI's September 30, 2026 quadratic-locus preprint, the boundary calculations yield algebraic comparisons with Picard-twelve K3 surfaces, with similarity multiplier two and generic Néron–Severi lattice $U\oplus D_{10}(-1)$. Independently of those assumptions, we construct an algebraic curve-product source for a four-dimensional Gaussian locus of Ma's known K3 target. A classical isotrivial K3 family is dominated by a Gaussian elliptic curve times a genus-seven cyclic curve. Hermitian classification, rational unitary density and Buskin's theorem transport this source to every K3 transcendental space contained in the specified rank-ten rational form with an orthogonal square root of minus one. Its source is $H^1(E_i)\otimes H^1(P)$ for a Prym fivefold, including after Picard-rank jumps. Huybrechts’s motivic isogeny theorem also gives a Chow motive of abelian type. The source conditionally transfers to the original selected cohomology on the open reached by the comparison. Reproducible CPU checks support the finite lattice and polynomial calculations. We distinguish these results from the known completion mechanism, known isotrivial constructions and existing Hodge theorems for CM-endomorphism K3 powers. The generic orthogonal locus still has no constructed abelian source, and the general rational Hodge conjecture remains open.
